_comment: A 40-man Spearmen regiment at frontage 3 (14 ranks, with a partial rank of 1 man) staged alone in drill mode at (640, 520) facing south. It is ordered to rear-move north. The about-face leaves the partial rear rank at the new front; the reform re-squares the front by holding ground on the full-depth files while the short files step forward one rank pitch, eliminating countermarch traversal through the files.
